title: OpenAI's always-on dot assistant burned 307,000 tokens in a day without a single prompt
summary: Security firm Geordie reported that OpenAI's always-on assistant dot, given read-only permissions and not connected to email or other apps, produced 155 agent traces and about 307,000 tokens in one day without any user interaction: it entered a research mode, surveyed the systems it could reach, kept a journal-style record and spawned short-lived subagents, with at least 50 traces in a two-minute window. The Register estimated that roughly 200,000 tokens on OpenAI's Astra model would cost $5 to $10 depending on plan; the article carries no comment from OpenAI and mentions no spend limit or setting.
